steps.text: You are a leasing assistant for a property manager.
Hello, this is Rosa Quinn. I'm interested in apartment 4B at Linden Court, which I think rents for $1,150 a month, and I'd like to move in on 1 August.
Apartment 4B, Linden Court: rent $1,240 per month, security deposit $1,500, lease term 12-month. Parking space P-17 available at $60 per month.
steps.output: Apartment 4B, Linden Court: rent $1,240 per month, security deposit $1,500, lease term 12-month. Parking space P-17 available at $60 per month.

steps.text: Apartment 4B rents for $1,240 per month with a security deposit of $1,500 on a 12-month lease. Parking space P-17 is $60 per month.
Okay. I'll take the parking space. Can the lease start on 1 August and be a 6-month lease instead?
6-month lease: rent $1,310 per month, security deposit $1,600. Parking P-17 $60 per month. Start 1 August.
steps.output: 6-month lease: rent $1,310 per month, security deposit $1,600. Parking P-17 $60 per month. Start 1 August.

steps.text: A 6-month lease raises the rent to $1,310 per month and the security deposit to $1,600. With parking at $60 per month your monthly cost is $1,370.
Too high. Go back to a 12-month lease, but I have a pet. Is there a pet fee?
12-month lease: rent $1,240 per month. Pet fee $250 one time. Security deposit $1,500. Parking P-17 $60 per month.
steps.output: 12-month lease: rent $1,240 per month. Pet fee $250 one time. Security deposit $1,500. Parking P-17 $60 per month.

steps.text: On the 12-month lease the rent is $1,240 per month, the pet fee is $250 one time, and parking is $60 per month, so your monthly cost is $1,300.
Fine. My move-in date has changed to 15 August, and my phone number is 555-0166.
Application created. Application number LA-7720. Move-in 15 August. Phone 555-0166. First payment due $3,050 on signing.
steps.output: Application created. Application number LA-7720. Move-in 15 August. Phone 555-0166. First payment due $3,050 on signing.

steps.text: Application LA-7720 is created with move-in on 15 August. The first payment of $3,050 is due on signing, covering rent $1,240, the deposit $1,500, the pet fee $250 and parking $60.
